vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ab-test-analyzer
Version: 1.0.2

The skill bundle contains standard documentation and metadata for an A/B testing analysis tool. The files (SKILL.md, skill.json, and _meta.json) describe legitimate data analysis functionality without any executable code, suspicious network calls, or prompt injection attempts.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (A/B test analysis and reporting) matches its instructions and there are no surprising installs, requested credentials, or out-of-scope behaviors.

dimensions.detail: Name, description and SKILL.md all describe A/B/multivariate analysis, reporting and recommendations. The skill does not request unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths — the requested surface is proportionate to this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays on-topic: it shows import/analyze/report commands and notes about sample size and confidence. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files, accessing unrelated environment variables, or posting to external endpoints. It expects the user to provide data files (e.g., test_data.csv), which is appropriate for this kind of tool.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files (instruction-only). That is low-risk; nothing will be downloaded or written to disk by an installer. Because this is an instruction-only skill, functionality depends on the platform running the described commands rather than bundled binaries.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. That is proportionate for an analytics/reporting skill. There are no unexpected secret/token requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable; standard autonomous invocation is allowed. The skill does not request persistent or cross-skill configuration or elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent, but consider: (1) it is instruction-only with no bundled code — the platform must execute the analysis logic, so verify where and how your CSV/test data will be processed (local vs remote) before sending sensitive data; (2) there is no network endpoint disclosed in SKILL.md, but confirm the platform’s runtime does not transmit data elsewhere; (3) skill.json in the package lists version 1.0.0 while registry metadata shows 1.0.2 — a minor inconsistency to be aware of; (4) validate statistical recommendations yourself (sample size, multiple comparisons) before making product changes. If you will upload PII or proprietary data, ensure the runtime environment and privacy policy are acceptable.
